fundamentals.name: Airbnb, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Airbnb, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a platform for stays, experiences, and services worldwide. The company's marketplace connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces, experiences, and services. It also offers gift cards. The company was formerly known as AirBed & Breakfast, Inc. and changed its name to Airbnb, Inc. in November 2010. Airbnb, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

judgment.summary: Strong growth and profitability metrics are supported by a reasonable forward P/E and significant free cash flow, despite a recent earnings miss.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter missed EPS estimates by 14.1%; next earnings date is 2026-08-05.
positives: Revenue growth 17.9% YoY, with analyst estimates for the current fiscal year at 25.2%.
Profit margin 19.9% and Return on Equity 32.3% indicate strong profitability.
Free cash flow of $3.19B TTM provides substantial financial flexibility.
Forward P/E of 22.23x is attractive relative to trailing P/E of 33.17x and analyst growth estimates.
Analyst consensus is 'buy' with a mean target price of $156.51.
negatives: Last quarter's EPS missed estimates by 14.1%.
Operating margin of 3.2% is relatively low compared to the gross margin.

news.paragraph: Airbnb's stock has seen recent positive attention, outperforming the market on June 1st and noted as a significant holding in Jeff Bezos's portfolio. While one article questions if the stock is underperforming the S&P 500, other reports highlight its recent gains and a GF Value estimate suggesting it is undervalued. The company is attracting investor interest, with a consensus 'buy' rating from analysts.
